cases.description: At least the declared number of characters of placeholder result is permitted: a placeholder whose result is exactly that long produces it whole, with nothing to report.

A placeholder whose result would carry the output past the limit resolves to the empty string instead, output-limit is reported once with origin limit, and the message's own text around it still renders.
The walk carries on past the output limit, and a result the output had no room for spends none of the budget, so the placeholder after it resolves and is carried.

At least the declared number of characters of value text is permitted, whether or not any of it reaches the output: a placeholder reading exactly that much and selecting nothing from it resolves, with nothing to report.

The read limit is tested before a placeholder reads, so one that found a budget and spent it past the limit still resolves; the next resolves to the empty string, and read-limit is reported once with origin limit.
A serialization that reaches the conversion limit is a conversion that cannot describe the value: the placeholder takes the chain and unserializable-value is reported with origin payload.

A value no conversion can describe produces no text and spends none of the read budget, however much text its serialization would have written: the placeholder takes the chain, unserializable-value is reported with origin payload, and the placeholder after it resolves and is carried.
At least the declared number of levels of placeholder is resolved, counting the outermost as the first: a message nesting exactly that many resolves through to the innermost, with nothing to report.
A placeholder nested deeper than the implementation resolves is a message error: it takes its fallback chain, the walk carries on, and nesting-limit is reported once with origin message.

The nesting limit is decided after the value is looked up and converted: a placeholder nested too deep whose value cannot be described reports unserializable-value with origin payload, then nesting-limit with origin message, and takes its fallback chain.

A placeholder nested too deep reads its value before it is refused, so its value spends the read budget: it takes its fallback chain, and the placeholder after it resolves to the empty string and reports read-limit.

The read limit is tested before anything else: a placeholder nested too deep that is reached once the budget is spent resolves to the empty string and reports read-limit, rather than taking its fallback chain as nesting-limit.
The nesting limit is decided before a modifier nobody registered: a placeholder nested too deep that names one reports nesting-limit with origin message alone, and takes its fallback chain.
The nesting limit is decided before a selection with no options: a placeholder nested too deep that selects from none reports nesting-limit with origin message alone, and takes its fallback chain.

No limit raises: a chain of inline defaults nested twenty thousand levels past the nesting limit resolves to its innermost text, each refused placeholder taking its chain and reporting nesting-limit once with origin message.
